bonds.analysis: While the request asks for a diversified portfolio across equities, bonds, and commodities, my role is specifically to manage the fixed-income allocation. Therefore, I will focus on designing a laddered bond portfolio that fits within the constraints provided. The laddered structure will spread maturities evenly across the next 10 years, with no more than 30% in any single year, to ensure a steady cash flow and reduce interest rate risk. The proposed allocation will be heavily weighted towards the front end of the curve (1-3 years) and gradually decrease as maturities extend, maintaining the portfolio's duration below 7 years to avoid flagging.
